grades.reason: This is LoongArch pseudocode for single-precision to signed-word conversion. It shows a 2-bit rm input selecting among ties-to-even, toward-zero, toward-positive and toward-negative rounding, with I_en choosing the exact variant. It never mentions FCSR, the global rounding mode field, or how a conversion instruction chooses between FCSR rounding and its own fixed rounding. So it gives only auxiliary detail on the rm encoding.
